description: Source code for map manipulation functions in the Wesnoth game editor, including map resizing, flipping, flood fill, and tile retrieval.

methods.name: grow_and_pad
methods.description: Private helper function to grow or pad the map in height or width.

methods.name: get_tiles
methods.description: Returns a list of map locations within a given radius around a central point.

methods.name: flood_fill
methods.description: Fills an area of the map with a specified terrain starting from a location.

methods.name: get_component
methods.description: Finds all connected map locations with the same terrain starting from a location.

methods.name: resize_map
methods.description: Resizes the map to new dimensions, filling new areas with a specified terrain.

methods.name: flip_map
methods.description: Flips the map horizontally or vertically.

methods.name: valid_mapdata
methods.description: Checks if map data string is valid and can be parsed into a map.
